items.title: Look over the workshop slides
items.quote: No rush at all, but if you get a chance could you look over the workshop slides before Thursday?
items.note: Softened request: 'if you get a chance' is politeness, not a condition, so implied, not speculative. 0.55 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.65, Maybe.

items.title: Share the attendee survey results
items.quote: It would be lovely if you could also share the attendee survey results at some point.
items.note: Softened, no date ('at some point' is never a date). 0.55 + 0.05 = 0.60, Maybe.

items.title: Send Leo the signed room booking form
items.quote: Please send me the signed room booking form by Wednesday, Oct 21.
items.note: Control: 0.80 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.90, Likely. Oct 21, 2026 is a Wednesday.
